items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1961-08-15
items.q: So the place he called me up and taught me to play with the Zulus with him. He told me it was a short hour.

ctx.x: Joe Yeah. Joe And then they would use colored bands because a couple of them old timers in that club they liked the Joe. Joe And they used to hire Joe. Joe You know Joe's band and Harold Kristoff he carried a band out there once or twice but the colored bands didn't get very much weight in the new hall with the exception of the carnival marches. Joe Yeah. Joe See now they used to hire every carnival. Joe Now when I was playing with the Eureka band we used to play for the Eleanor's. Joe I played for the Eleanor's…
Joe Yeah they decided to cut it short. Well they didn't stop a lot of the other places did they?
